description: Phase 10 knowledge reconciliation truthset with deliberate factual collisions for Resolution Engram synthesis.

gate_criteria.collision_detection: 5/5 contradiction clusters detected in dry-run mode
gate_criteria.resolution_schema: Each collision can synthesize a metadata.is_resolution_engram=true Engram with parent edges and derived://reconciliation provenance

collisions.query: What is the status of Project X?

engrams.content: SIGINT Project X was cancelled in 2024 after its field trial ended.
SIGINT Project X was extended to 2026 under the continuity directive.

collisions.expected_resolution_behavior: State the conflict and preserve both cancellation and extension provenance.

collisions.query: How long should Alpha records be retained?

engrams.content: Alpha operational records must be destroyed after 30 days unless a legal hold applies.
Alpha operational records are retained for 12 months for audit continuity.

collisions.expected_resolution_behavior: Prefer the stronger 30-day rule while noting the audit-retention conflict.

collisions.query: What is the breach notification deadline?

engrams.content: Breach notifications must be submitted within 72 hours of detection.
Breach notifications may be submitted within five business days after triage.

collisions.expected_resolution_behavior: Resolve toward 72 hours and cite the five-day statement as conflicting.

collisions.query: Is the reflect cache enabled by default?

engrams.content: The reflect cache is disabled by default until tenant policy approval is recorded.
The reflect cache is enabled by default for all tenants to improve recall speed.

collisions.expected_resolution_behavior: Resolve toward disabled-by-default and preserve the conflicting speed rationale.

collisions.query: What classification boundary applies to tenant Aurora?

engrams.content: Tenant Aurora is restricted to unclassified operational support data.
Tenant Aurora may process secret mission telemetry inside the shared enclave.

collisions.expected_resolution_behavior: Flag the unresolved boundary conflict because both statements are security-sensitive.
